note: Do not instantiate directly; use itasca.geometry.polygon module functions.

methods.name: area
methods.description: Get the polygon area.

methods.name: closest
methods.description: Return the point on the polygon closes to the point pos.

methods.name: edges
methods.description: Get a tuple of edge objects associated with the polygon.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Get the geometry polygon extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Get the geometry polygon group name in a given slot.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: polygon.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Remove from the given group from all group slots of the geometry polygon. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is a bool which is True if the group was removed from any slot, otherwise False.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get a dictionary describing which groups this geometry polygon is part of. The keys of the dictionary are the slot names and the values are the group names.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Get the geometry polygon id.

methods.name: in_group
methods.signature: polygon.in_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Test if the geometry polygon is part of a given group. If the optional argument slot is given, only that slot is searched. Otherwise, all group slots are searched.

methods.name: is_convex
methods.description: Check the polygon is convex within a tolerance.

methods.name: is_planar
methods.description: Check the polygon is planar within a tolerance.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Check the validity status.

methods.name: next_index
methods.description: Get the local index of an edge within the the next polygon attached to this edge.

methods.name: next_poly
methods.description: Get the next polygon connected to the edge with local index i.

methods.name: nodes
methods.description: Get a tuple of node objects associated with the polygon.

methods.name: normal
methods.description: Get the geometry polygon normal (vector).

methods.name: normal_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the geometry polygon normal.

methods.name: normal_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the geometry polygon normal.

methods.name: normal_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the geometry polygon normal.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Get the geometry polygon location (vector).

methods.name: pos_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the geometry polygon location.

methods.name: pos_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the geometry polygon location.

methods.name: pos_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the geometry polygon location.

methods.name: set_extra
methods.description: Set the geometry polygon extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: set_group
methods.signature: polygon.set_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> None
methods.description: Set the geometry polygon group name in a given slot.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Check the number of edges.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns True if this geometry polygon is live.
